mapper.sql: id ,course_name,type_id, course_desc,course_status,mentor, mentor_photo,mentor_introduction,cover, background_image,create_by, create_time,update_by,update_time, delete_flag
mapper.select: select ct.type_name as typeName, ci.* from course_info ci left join course_type ct on ci.type_id = ct.id and ct.delete_flag = 0 where ci.id = #{id} and ci.delete_flag = 0
select ci.mentor as mentor, ci.mentor_photo as mentorPhoto, ci.mentor_introduction as mentorIntroduction from course_info ci where ci.id = #{id} and ci.delete_flag = 0

select ci.*,ct.type_name as typeName from course_info ci left join course_type ct on ci.type_id = ct.id where ci.delete_flag = 0 and ct.delete_flag = 0
and ci.course_name like concat('%',#{courseName},'%')
group by ci.type_id

select ci.* from course_learn cl left join chapter_info cai on cai.id = cl.chapter_id left join course_info ci on ci.id = cai.course_id where cl.user_id = #{userId} and ci.delete_flag = 0 order by cl.create_time desc

select ci.*,ct.type_name as typeName,ct.remark as typeRemark, ce1.explore_name as exploreName, ce2.explore_name as exploreParentName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cl.label_name SEPARATOR ',') AS labelName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cl.id SEPARATOR ',') AS labelIds from course_info ci left join course_type ct on ci.type_id = ct.id left join course_and_label cal on cal.course_id = ci.id left join course_label cl on cal.label_id = cl.id left join course_explore ce1 on ci.explore_id = ce1.id left join course_explore ce2 on ci.explore_parent_id = ce2.id where ci.delete_flag = 0
and ci.course_name like concat('%',#{courseName},'%')
and ct.type_name like concat('%',#{typeName},'%')
and ci.course_title like concat('%',#{courseTitle},'%')
and ci.mentor_title like concat('%',#{mentorTitle},'%')
and ci.mentor like concat('%',#{mentor},'%')
and ci.course_status = #{courseStatus}
GROUP BY ci.id, ct.type_name, ct.remark ORDER BY ci.create_time desc
